payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over i from 0 to n-1 and two linear values (b-a, -a-b) to compute u = k*i + offset, then gcd(u, n*k); collect all gcds; min and max of n*k/gcd give answer.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tries all possible relative offsets derived from a and b, without recursion or pruning. It is a brute-force complete search, not a true backtracking, but among the given subtypes it is the most generic match.
